item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. We will not accept a billion lives lost to superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, that catastrophe will follow. We are fighting for a legally binding prohibition—not voluntary promises.

3. We believe humanity deserves a future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe killing at least a billion people. We must prohibit its development before that future is destroyed.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are clear about what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to accept that future. No one knows how to build these systems safely, and we cannot allow their developers to gamble with humanity’s survival. We are fighting for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence—not another voluntary pledge, not another promise to put safety first. We must turn public concern into political action. Together, we can demand enforceable limits, hold decision-makers accountable, and protect the future that belongs to all of us.
